title: 第29章 失控！失控！失控！
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
时间一晃，来到夜晚。

    帝王寝殿里。

    秦然赶走所有太监侍卫，孤身一人躺在床榻上。

    他紧闭双眸。

    脑海魂宫当中，一只浑身燃着金色火焰的漂亮鸾鸟，正漂浮在半空。

    远看这是一只鸾鸟，凑近看，却仅是一只鸾鸟形态的奇异铭文。

    “这就是龙雀真王拳？”

    秦然诧异。

    经过半天时间的融合分解，云宫掠天术成功将龙雀真王拳复刻了出来。

    他伸出一根手指点在符文上。

    金色鸾鸟振翅飞舞，嗖的一声，钻入了他的灵魂体当中……

    呼！！

    秦然周身猛地掀起金色火焰。

    他缓缓抬起拳头，体内灵力如潮水般朝手臂中灌入。

    灵力沸腾，气势猛增。

    拳锋处，火焰愈发炽烈惊人，周遭温度暴涨。

    隐约可见，一尊骇人的神魔虚影盘坐于火焰中央，凶焰滔天！

    “第一重，一象镇狱！”

    秦然一拳挥出，神魔虚影同时出拳，神魔虚影的所有力道全部灌入秦然拳头当中，借着他的拳势，霸道地轰向前方。

    轰隆隆！！

    魂宫剧烈一颤。

    秦然动作不停，行云流水地继续出拳。

    “第二重，三象焚天！”

    拳锋上的火焰再度暴涨，三尊神魔虚影浮现，拳头上的力道猛增。

    “第三重，九象归墟！！”

    呼。

    一声暴喝，他整个人燃了起来。

    周身完全被金色火焰覆盖，宛如金焰圣灵，在其身后，一尊尊神魔虚影接连浮现。

    每出现一尊神魔，他的气息便暴涨一截，足足九尊神魔出现，他的气息达到了一个前所未有的顶点！

    金焰中央，俊美青年黑发飞舞，金色双眸中充斥着睥睨霸道之意。

    与往日的纨绔轻佻判若两人。

    他慢慢抬起拳，九尊神魔同时出拳，所有力道猛灌入他一人手臂当中。

    啪！啪！

    脆弱的皮肉经脉，承受不住恐怖力道，接连崩开一道道血口子。

    血流如注！

    秦然恍若未觉，脚下踏着白色仙云，身形朝前方连续爆闪，一拳轰了出去。

    轰隆隆！！

    这一拳，裹挟着神魔之威，一往无前。

    魂宫中，空间被这一拳压缩得传出悲鸣声，整座魂宫震颤不止……

    秦然笑了，脱力地瘫倒在地。
content_en:
Time passed and it came to night.

In the emperor's bedroom.

Qin Ran drove away all the eunuch guards and lay alone on the bed.

He closed his eyes tightly.

In the soul palace of his mind, a beautiful luan bird with golden flames all over its body was floating in the air.

From a distance, it looks like a Luan bird, but when you look closer, it's just a strange inscription in the shape of a Luan bird.

"Is this the Dragon Bird True King Fist?"

Qin Ran was surprised.

After half a day of fusion and decomposition, Yun Gong's Heaven-plundering Technique successfully reproduced the Dragon Bird True King Fist.

He pointed a finger at the rune.

The golden phoenix flapped its wings and flew into his soul with a whooshing sound...

Phew!!

Qin Ran's whole body suddenly erupted into golden flames.

He slowly raised his fist, and the spiritual power in his body poured into his arm like a tide.

The spiritual energy boils and the momentum surges.

At the edge of the fist, the flames became more and more intense, and the surrounding temperature skyrocketed.

Vaguely visible, a terrifying phantom of a god and demon sat in the middle of the flames, the fierce flames overwhelming the sky!

"The first level, one elephant suppresses the prison!"

Qin Ran punched out, and the phantom of the gods and demons punched at the same time. All the power of the phantoms of the gods and demons was poured into Qinran's fist, and with the help of his fist, he blasted forward domineeringly.

Boom!!

The Soul Palace trembled violently.

Qin Ran kept moving and continued punching smoothly.

"Second level, three elephants burning the sky!"

The flames on the fist's edge surged again, the shadows of the three gods and demons appeared, and the power on the fist increased sharply.

"Third level, Nine Elephants Return to Ruins!!"

Phew.

With a loud shout, his whole body was on fire.

The whole body was completely covered by golden flames, like the Holy Spirit of Golden Flames. Behind him, the phantoms of gods and demons appeared one after another.

Every time a god and demon appeared, his aura surged. When nine gods and demons appeared, his aura reached an unprecedented peak!

In the center of the golden flame, a handsome young man's black hair was flying, and his golden eyes were full of domineering look.

He is completely different from the dandy and frivolous person in the past.

He slowly raised his fist, and the nine gods and demons punched at the same time, and all the power was poured into one of his arms.

Snap!Snap!

The fragile skin and meridians could not withstand the terrifying force, and bloody wounds opened one after another.

The blood is flowing!

Qin Ran seemed unaware, with white fairy clouds under his feet, his body flashed forward continuously, and he punched out.

Boom!!

This punch carried the power of gods and demons and moved forward indomitably.

In the Soul Palace, the space was compressed by this punch to the point of screaming, and the entire Soul Palace was shaking...

Qin Ran laughed and collapsed to the ground exhausted.
